lines.en: Ride the warm current. Saves effort.
Three fin-flicks. Forward a little.
Coral on the left. Don't bump it.
Water's shallow. Light above me.
Swim slow. Don't draw eyes.
That seagrass will hide me.
Water through my gills. Cool.
Hug the sandy bottom. Safer.
A school went by. Follow them.
One loop around this rock.
Current's picking up. Hold steady.
Rise a little. Look at the surface.
I'm not fast, but I'm steady.
Bubbles race up in strings.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里凉，我钻进去歇会。
lines.en: The coral crevice is cool. I slip in to rest.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来一点，又慢慢放平。
lines.en: I puff up a little, then slowly settle.
Draw water in. Puff up a little.
Touch me and I turn into a pincushion.
That little fish isn't afraid of me?
Gills open and close. I count them.
Quiet in this coral gap.
Iron taste in the water. Not good.
Spines are folded. Don't misread me.
Warm water feels just right.
A shadow slides over the coral.
In the hole, only my eyes showing.
Two bites of seagrass. Tasteless.
Belly's round. Time to deflate.

lines.zh: 这片水域的鱼都认识我。
lines.en: The fish here all know me.
Just hover. Save the effort.
A big one. Still staring.
Keep that hand where it is.
I'm this small. What do you want?
You make so many bubbles.
I saw the net.
You swim faster than me. Don't chase.
My poison tastes awful. Truly.
Your boots crushed the coral.
Why stare? Go away.
I puff up a size. You back off.
Ai. Something pricked me!
A bite took a corner of my fin.
My spines won't fold back.
Hurts. I curl into a ball.
A little red in the water.
I sink onto the sand, not moving.
Don't touch me while it hurts.
Gills racing. I can't breathe right.
Give me a moment, then I'll swim off.
This little wound. Bubbles will fix it.
That scrap of food? Not interested.

lines.zh: 我吃海草，不吃你手里的。
lines.en: I eat seagrass, not what's in your hand.
You keep waving it. The water's churned.
Trying to bait me? So predictable.

lines.zh: 我肚子里已经有东西了。
lines.en: My belly's already full.
Set it on the rock. Then step back.
I'd rather nibble the algae on that rock.
Too hard. I couldn't bite it.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，刺会立起来。
lines.en: Don't come closer. My spines rise.

lines.zh: 这点东西换不来我的信任。
lines.en: That won't buy my trust.
Bump me and your hand will swell.
Spines are up. Back off.
You pushed me into the coral.
Don't drop a bucket over me.
Even a light touch stings. Understand?
I'm inflated. Stop squeezing.
You've stirred up all the sand.
I bounced away. Don't follow.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我转了半圈。
lines.en: That spun me half around.
Sorry. I'm all spines.
Let me see if your spines are even.

lines.zh: 暖水区才有心思谈这个。
lines.en: Only in warm water do I think of it.
My nest is behind the coral.
Water's too cold now. Not discussing it.
Turn slowly. Let me look at you.
Don't puff up. That doesn't impress me.
We swim our own ways. That's fine.
Ask again when the water warms.
You swim too fast. I can't keep up.
Let's find a quiet little bay together.

lines.zh: 这块礁石上有藻，刮一点。
lines.en: Algae on this rock. Scrape a little off.

lines.zh: 亮亮的东西沉下来了，看看。
lines.en: Something shiny sank. Let me look.
Don't take that. I hid it.
This shell blocks the current.
I'll carry a pebble for fun.
Too heavy. Can't push it.
What sinks into the sand is mine.
I only pick up soft things.
A pearl. Hide it in my hole.
Two nudges with my mouth. Buried.
A net's coming down. Hide!
That big one's flipping the coral.
Something nipped my fin.
Into the crevice. Don't move.

lines.zh: 它抢了我的藻，我记住了。
lines.en: It took my algae. I remember.
Sand everywhere. I can't see.
Puff up first. Startle it.
That hook has something on it.
The shrimp is fleeing. I can't catch it.
It fears my spines. It won't come close.
Every spine, standing up.
Puff, puff, a little more.
One step closer and I double in size.
Small doesn't mean easy.
My eyes are behind the spines.
Air makes me round as a ball.
It's hesitating. Keep it up.
I turn sideways, blocking my hole.
Underwater, you can't see my mouth.
Three seconds, then I deflate.
You touched the spines. Done for.
The poison's already in your hand.
A small nudge from me.

lines.zh: 你手麻了？那是我的功劳。
lines.en: Your hand's numb? That was me.
Don't rub it. That pushes it deeper.
I bit you. My teeth are tiny.
Go back and rinse it in water.
A spine broke off in you. My loss.
I only wanted you to let go.
That'll remind you for a day.
Warm water. The light's just right.
Slip out of the coral gap.
Water's just deep enough here.
Little fish all around. Safe.
I puff up. Take a look around.
Clean sand. A good place to live.
Light patches moving up there.
Noise from the reef side.
This is my new patch of water.
Sink slowly. Settle on the bottom.
The water's hot. My fins are curling!
Flung into the air, dropped on the sand.

lines.zh: 我本来就是鱼，怎么会淹？
lines.en: I'm a fish. How am I drowning?
The blast shattered the coral.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西插进我的肚子。
lines.en: Something sharp went into my belly.
This light makes me dizzy. Spines going soft.
Days without a bite of algae.
The surface burst. I flipped over.
No sand beneath me. Only dark.
